leadText:
Terapagos's Exploration Diary (Japanese: テラパゴスのキラキラ Terapagos's Brilliant Exploration Diary) is a series of three focusing on that were shown at the end of episodes in the Japanese version of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, replacing the regular bonus segment Professor Friede's Pokémon Seminar from HZ031 to HZ033, which originally aired from December 1 to December 15, 2023. The shorts were also uploaded separately to the official Japanese Pokémon X (formerly Twitter) account to promote a playlist of episodes featuring Terapagos that were available on the official Japanese Pokémon YouTube channel from December 1 to 15, 2023.

They were subsequently released with Japanese audio and English, Traditional Chinese, and Indonesian subtitles on the official Asian Pokémon YouTube channels on December 25, 2024. The Pokémon Asia ENG uploads additionally include an advertisement for the TCG expansion and Pokémon Horizons: The Series.

Terapagos's Exploration Diary (Japanese: テラパゴスのキラキラ Terapagos's Brilliant Exploration Diary) is a series of three focusing on that were shown at the end of episodes in the Japanese version of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, replacing the regular bonus segment Professor Friede's Pokémon Seminar from HZ031 to HZ033, which originally aired from December 1 to December 15, 2023. The shorts were also uploaded separately to the official Japanese Pokémon X (formerly Twitter) account to promote a playlist of episodes featuring Terapagos that were available on the official Japanese Pokémon YouTube channel from December 1 to 15, 2023.

They were subsequently released with Japanese audio and English, Traditional Chinese, and Indonesian subtitles on the official Asian Pokémon YouTube channels on December 25, 2024. The Pokémon Asia ENG uploads additionally include an advertisement for the TCG expansion and Pokémon Horizons: The Series.

==List of segments==
 
 
 
 
 

==Vol. 1==
 
Vol. 1 was shown with HZ031.
===Summary===
Terapagos follows throughout the Brave Olivine. Sprigatito is annoyed at first, but eventually accepts Terapagos's company, even letting it sleep next to her.

==Vol. 2==
 
Vol. 2 was shown with HZ032.
===Summary===
Terapagos explores the Brave Olivine at night, finding the other Pokémon sleeping together. rolls over in his sleep and bumps into , who is startled and freezes over the floor with , causing Terapagos to slide around with Fuecoco, until they bump into a box of Oran Berries. ==Vol. 3==
 
Vol. 3 was shown with HZ033.
===Summary===
Feeling hungry, Terapagos wanders into the Brave Olivine's kitchen, where produces some cream for it and , while gives them some of its juice. The cream and the juice end up spilling all over the kitchen, much to the horror of , who tries to clean up the mess, but fails. Eventually, Dot enters the kitchen to find it and the Pokémon covered in cream and juice.

===Characters===

This short was uploaded with the description "Another busy day for Quaxly aboard the Brave Olivine airship!" (Japanese: 賑やかなブレイブアサギ号で、クワッスは今日も大忙し！).
 

==Trivia==
These segments follow the same style as Pikachu's Vacation or Pikachu & Pichu, where and the Pokémon from the main characters are the protagonists and the human characters appear briefly (usually from the back or with their faces not shown in the short).
They are the first shorts from the animated series to star only Pokémon since Where Are You Going, Eevee?, almost four years earlier.
The Pokémon Asia ENG uploads of the shorts mispell the video titles as Terapagos's Exploratoin day Vol. 1, Terapagos's Exploratoin day vol.2, and Terapagos's Exploratoin Diary vol.3. However, the video thumbnail and subtitles spell the title correctly.
